_contract: Karos landing-engine brand contract — NEUTRAL EXAMPLE for the canonical template. Matches the placeholder skin in src/app/globals.css + the example content in src/content/example.ts. Replaced wholesale per client; this exists so the template self-verifies against gate.mjs out of the box.

identity.positioning: build it once, ship it everywhere
identity.mood: neutral dark slate ground with one cool-blue accent

fonts.display: Space Grotesk (display headlines + key figures) — Google Fonts
fonts.mono: JetBrains Mono (stats, labels, eyebrows) — Google Fonts
fonts.rule: max 2 type families in active use; mono for numbers/labels only

brandLaw: This is the NEUTRAL template default, not a final client look. Per client, overwrite tokens + fonts + content wholesale.
Accent used sparingly (~8%): primary CTAs, key figures, active states. Ground stays the dominant field.
Clean, direct copy; avoid slop. AA contrast on every text surface. en-US.

voice.lead: what the product does + how fast you get value
